final_lessons: For this dataset, RMSprop with lr 0.01 can dominate much slower SGD or tiny-lr Adagrad even on a small width-16 MLP.
Compact ReLU MLPs with layer norm and mse_l1 lambda 0.01 can beat larger slow-SGD models by a wide margin here.
SGD lr 0.01 with a residual width-16 MLP can substantially outperform slower SGD and tiny-lr Adagrad here.
Width-128 residual MLPs can work well even with plain MSE and low-lr SGD, beating smaller or deeper slow-SGD baselines.
A shallow layer-normalized width-64 MLP with AdamW lr 0.0003 and plain MSE can be among the strongest options here.
Residual normalized MLPs trained with RMSprop can beat slow-SGD baselines even at lr 0.0003.
A width-128 residual MLP can tolerate Adam lr 0.01 and still strongly outperform weak slow-SGD or Adagrad baselines here.
Adagrad can be extremely strong here when lr is 0.01; the earlier failure was the tiny 0.0001 learning rate, not Adagrad itself.
Residual width-32 Adagrad remains strong at lr 0.001, easily beating the known slow-SGD baselines.
